versions.changelog: Send only what about the person bears on this ask, not a standing profile.
Hand the cards over rather than audit them: the reply rules no longer ask the model to pick, reorder or take time. limit says to leave it out, and why a smaller ask is not a faster one.
The request brief asks who the person is and what they have liked before, not only this evening's constraints. effort is no longer offered: one tier is served.

Answers carry the New York clock again, which the tool change had dropped; the reply no longer quotes a per-call credit figure that read as the price of the next page. get_details is documented with kind: experience, lng and when.end gained descriptions, the tool definitions are labelled as the Responses API shape with the wrapper Chat Completions needs, and guidance no longer assumes every request is an evening out.

One tool, one call: find_things_to_do takes the request as a sentence and answers it ranked, each result carrying the reason it is there. search_directions is gone, and with it the instruction to split a request into several searches or to re-rank what comes back.
Initial release: live New York experiences search for agents
